The asmap benchmark thinks that the address `3fff::1` belongs to AS16509. Not sure if the bug is in the asmap file or our parser.

Edit:

Hmm
```
::/2 AS16509
```

I think it's the asmap file.

The last asmap generation was quite short notice, though a score of 10/14 reproductions is also not terrible. Might a backported run be warranted? 

And CC @fjahr and @jurraca for the CI problem.

events.message: kernel: update assumed blockchain and chainstate sizes

events.body: Dropped the asmap update. I believe this is just an encoding issue where asmap-tool is not accounting for prefixes that are not supposed to be reachable. All asmaps more recent than the current embedding contain the problematic mapping.
